input: SHA-pinned local JSONL, actor filter before record validation; no network or database reads
captureMeaning: A declared exact request/output capture, not an authenticated observed event or proof of physical completion. Existing episodes/reward exports lack this contract and cannot be upgraded by inference.
request: Versioned canonical system/task/context renderer, model artifact or explicit editorial identity, sampling, source version and actor-owned memory provenance; each candidate and review pins the same request SHA
admission: Strict schemas; existing proposalSchema and reviewNarrative; exactly two participants; no newRole; chosen needs explicit human/agent semantic review of relevance, knowledge, causality and Vietnamese. Heuristic scores cannot approve records.
dpo: Explicit reviewed chosen/rejected references and completion hashes, distinct outputs, exactly the same rendered prompt/context/model/sampling/source snapshot; rejected need not pass validators but its actual validator result is retained
splits: Deterministic 80/10/10 SHA partitions of connected source/scene/prompt/context groups, never separate a pair; no quality evaluation or claimed statistical independence
exports: Versioned private actor-scoped artifact with source/validator/dataset hashes, approved few-shot and DPO arrays per split; offline few-shot selector uses train only, compatible actor/model/prompt/participants/location and excludes the target scene/source
writes: Default preview writes nothing; explicit export atomically creates a mode600 file exclusively under .sites-runtime/training, rejects symlink parents, never overwrites input/output
preservation: No runtime importer, training, promotion, paid API/GPU, world/memory/history/policy/schema/scheduler or renderer changes; H10 holdout remains unopened
fixtures: New explicitly reviewed synthetic fixtures only. Legacy 6 SFT/6 partial DPO examples remain editorial references, not retroactively matched model captures.
